change: Keep an explicit fresh_stream marker at startup and after actual stream resets. After read_count returns a block and read_exact succeeds, refresh once immediately before accepting its first real PCM samples. Padding silence does not perform the new refresh.
Invalid update keeps the original decoder context, but cannot keep retrying mid-utterance.
